Companion Animal Travel Desk Operations: Why This Page Matters
This page helps new staff process companion animal travel requests for Aurelia Skyways and maintain safe, respectful coordination for passengers and pets. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is the front-line desk that guides travelers through every step, while the cabin team monitors the animal during the flight. Strong desk discipline prevents missed requirements, late communications, and avoidable stress for animals like Millie.

Start by confirming traveler identity, contact details, and the companion animal’s status with clear, calm messaging. Yara Khan may be anxious about the itinerary, so your tone must stay precise and supportive. Sana Moretti may ask about documents while the desk is still collecting information, so you should explain next actions in simple terms and set expectations for timing.

Item 1: For booking, complete the process within 84 hours of submission.
Item 2: For arrival pickup, submit the form FM-394 with the passenger record.

Use the standard workflow: log the request, verify that the passenger’s details match the pet record, and check any operational constraints before you confirm acceptance. When you request missing information, record what you asked for and the timestamp of your request, then follow up on schedule without escalation unless the situation requires it. Communicate with the cabin team through the approved channel, and include concise operational notes needed for safe monitoring. Confirm outbound coordination early, and maintain a clean handoff for arrival, including clear pickup instructions and any special handling flags.

Always document outcomes after each interaction, because future staff will rely on your notes during disruption or day-of changes. Keep conversations professional, avoid jargon, and treat every pet as a living passenger with dignity. Remember that documentation, timing, and respectful communication are non-negotiable.
